title: How a Sink P-Trap Functionally Blocks Gas
description: A sink P-trap is a critical, simple hydraulic device installed directly below fixture drains. Gravity directs wastewater through the tailpiece and around the curved dip of the trap bend. Once flow stops, liquid remains trapped in the low dip, creating a continuous airtight hydraulic seal. This water column prevents dangerous and foul-smelling sewer gases from escaping up into the living space. Simultaneously, the smooth curvature allows solid particles to wash through efficiently when correct slope and volume are maintained, protecting both indoor air quality and drain flow integrity.

How a Sink P-Trap Functionally Blocks Gas

A sink P-trap is a critical, simple hydraulic device installed directly below fixture drains. Gravity directs wastewater through the tailpiece and around the curved dip of the trap bend. Once flow stops, liquid remains trapped in the low dip, creating a continuous airtight hydraulic seal. This water column prevents dangerous and foul-smelling sewer gases from escaping up into the living space. Simultaneously, the smooth curvature allows solid particles to wash through efficiently when correct slope and volume are maintained, protecting both indoor air quality and drain flow integrity.
